title: SGR-J1935
body:
# Introduction

[**SGR-J1935**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SGR_1935%2B2154) is smallest star known to human-kind, therefore our modpack tries to keep to the it's name, and don't put that much in a modpack and only tries to optimize gameplay, not breaking compatibility with servers or other clients that might play with you.

# Extensions

There are only two extensions of SGR-J1935, and you're currently looking at one of them.

- [LMC X-4](https://modrinth.com/modpack/lmc-x-4) does the exact same as SGR-J1935 with trying to improve performance of gameplay, but also tries to enchance it with [Quality of Life](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quality_of_life) mods (keeping it close to vanilla)

# Version System

SGR-J1935 (and extensions) uses `W.X.Y.Z` format for release versions.

- `W` will increment each new Minecraft version release.
- `X` will increment with any changes to the list of mods.
- `Y` will increment with any updates to any mods in the list.
- `Z` will increment with any hotfixes to the modpack.
